rainfall.disclaimer: Operational demonstration thresholds — not calibrated against historical landslide event rainfall.

risk_fusion.description: Deterministic rule matrix combining static susceptibility tier and dynamic rainfall trigger level.
risk_fusion.disclaimer: Operational risk level and score represent a deterministic engineering synthesis; not a calibrated statistical event probability.

scoring.score_semantics: This is an engineering synthesis score used for ordering/visualization. It is not a probability, calibrated hazard score, or empirically validated landslide risk estimate. The categorical risk_level is the authoritative operational decision.
